Our Story

More Than a Salon —
It's an Experience

✦

"Every client who walks through our doors deserves to leave feeling like the most beautiful version of themselves."

TA's Beauty Lounge was built on a simple but powerful belief: that professional beauty services should be accessible, personalised, and transformative. Nestled in the heart of Halfway Gardens, Midrand, our studio has become a sanctuary where artistry meets care.

Our team of highly skilled beauty professionals — led by the talented Portia and Natasha — bring years of experience, a passion for perfection, and an eye for detail to every single treatment. From intricately designed nail art to semi-permanent eyebrow transformations, we approach every appointment as a unique canvas.

We believe beauty is deeply personal. That's why we take the time to understand what you envision, source the exact colours and products needed, and deliver results that exceed expectations — every time. Our 4.8-star rating across 53 Google reviews isn't just a number; it's a reflection of the trust our community places in us.

What We Offer

Our Services

✦

From precision eyebrow artistry to luxurious nail design, every service at TA's Beauty Lounge is delivered with expert hands and a commitment to excellence. Click any category to explore our full menu.

🪮
Eyebrows
2 services
+
Microshading Ombre Brows
R1,600
⏱ 1 hr 30 min Semi-Permanent

A revolutionary semi-permanent makeup technique where pigment is inserted under the skin using tiny, pin-like dots in a gradient pattern, creating a beautiful powdered brow effect. Microshading achieves a soft, diffused finish that mimics the appearance of professionally applied brow powder — ideal for all skin types, including oily skin where microblading may not hold as well. The technique creates a gradient effect that is darker at the tail and lighter at the front, mimicking the natural look of fuller brows. Results are immediate and stunning, though the colour will soften by 30–40% during healing. A touch-up is recommended 6–8 weeks after your first appointment, after which your beautiful brows can last anywhere from one to three years depending on your skin type and aftercare routine.

Microshading / Microblading / Ombre Brows Touch-Up
R1,100
⏱ 1 hr Touch-Up

Your essential perfecting session, scheduled 6 to 8 weeks after your initial eyebrow treatment. This follow-up appointment allows us to assess how your skin has healed, address any areas where pigment may not have fully retained, and make any final adjustments to shape, colour depth, or symmetry. Think of this touch-up as the second half of your brow transformation — it's where we fine-tune your results to ensure long-lasting, beautiful definition. Do not skip this step; it is a critical part of the semi-permanent process and included as a standalone bookable service.

💄
Special Occasion Makeup
1 service
+
All Occasions Makeup
from R700
⏱ 1 hr 20 min All Occasions

Whether you're walking down the aisle, attending a gala, celebrating a birthday, or making an impression at a corporate event — our professional makeup artists are here to bring your vision to life. We work with high-quality, long-lasting products suited to all skin tones and types, ensuring your look stays flawless from the first moment to the last. During your consultation, we discuss your desired look, the event dress code, your outfit and accessories, and any skin concerns, ensuring a truly bespoke and personalised finish. Pricing starts from R700 and varies based on complexity, product requirements, and look duration.

✨
Waxing
5 services
+
Brazilian Wax
R400
⏱ 35 min Ladies Only

Our Brazilian wax service offers complete, thorough hair removal performed with professional-grade wax by trained, experienced therapists in a private, respectful, and comfortable environment. We use only the highest quality wax formulas — warm wax for larger areas and hard wax for sensitive regions — to minimise discomfort and maximise results. Results typically last 3–6 weeks, and with regular waxing, hair regrows finer and sparser over time. Your comfort and dignity are our absolute priority throughout the entire treatment.

Full Face Wax
R230
⏱ 20 min

Achieve a perfectly smooth, radiant complexion with our full face waxing treatment. This service covers all areas of the face including the upper lip, chin, cheeks, jawline, and forehead — removing unwanted facial hair cleanly and efficiently. We use gentle, skin-safe wax formulas appropriate for sensitive facial skin, and follow up with soothing products to calm and protect the skin post-treatment. Great for achieving a smooth base for makeup application and maintaining a neat, polished appearance day to day.

Underarm Waxing
R100
⏱ 30 min Female Only

A quick, effective, and affordable treatment that delivers smooth, hair-free underarms for weeks at a time. Our underarm waxing service uses hard wax for this sensitive area, minimising skin irritation and pulling. We also ensure the area is properly cleansed and soothed post-treatment. Regular underarm waxing leads to progressively lighter, thinner regrowth — making each subsequent appointment more comfortable and your results longer-lasting.

¾ Leg Waxing
R220
⏱ 30 min Female Only

Silky-smooth legs from the knee down with our ¾ leg waxing service. Using professional warm wax applied with precision, this treatment removes hair efficiently across the lower three-quarters of the leg, leaving skin smooth and touchable for up to 4–6 weeks. Perfect for pre-event prep, summer readiness, or simply maintaining smooth skin year-round. We take care to work in sections for even coverage and a thorough result.

Brow Waxing & Shaping
R90
⏱ 30 min Female Only

Frame your face beautifully with our expert brow waxing and shaping service. Our therapists assess your natural brow growth pattern, face shape, and personal preferences to craft a clean, defined arch that enhances your features. We use precision waxing to remove stray hairs, create a crisp brow line, and define the arch — then finish with tweezers for any fine detail work. Regular brow shaping every 3–4 weeks keeps your look polished and groomed with minimal effort on your end.

💅
Nails
4 services
+
Nail Art & Custom Designs
From R350
⏱ 1 hr 30 min Bespoke

At TA's, nail art is not just a service — it's our signature. Portia and Natasha have developed a reputation across Midrand for creating extraordinary, intricate nail designs that are true works of art. Bring us any reference image, describe a mood or colour palette, or let our artists surprise you with their creativity. From florals and geometric patterns to detailed character art (like the much-loved comic nail designs that went viral with our clients), we approach every set as a miniature canvas. Pricing varies depending on complexity and length of design.

Acrylic & Gel Nails
From R300
⏱ 1 hr

Whether you prefer the durability of acrylics or the flexibility and natural appearance of gel nails, our technicians deliver flawless application that lasts. We offer full sets, infills, overlays, and extensions in a wide range of lengths, shapes (almond, coffin, stiletto, square, oval), and finishes (matte, shimmer, chrome, glitter, metallic). Our products are professional-grade and sourced for longevity and nail health — because beautiful nails should also be healthy nails.

Custom Colour Mixing
Included
⏱ As needed Exclusive

One of the most talked-about aspects of the TA's experience is our in-house custom colour mixing. Can't find the exact shade you're imagining? We'll create it from scratch. Whether it's a very specific dusty mauve, a bespoke terracotta-nude blend, or a colour you saw in a photo and can't name — our technicians will mix until we get it exactly right. This is the level of personalised service that keeps clients coming back and recommending us to everyone they know.

Manicure & Pedicure
From R180
⏱ 45–60 min

Treat your hands and feet to a classic manicure or pedicure that goes beyond mere polish. Our treatments include nail shaping and filing, cuticle care and removal, hand/foot soak and exfoliation, massage with nourishing oils, and a perfect polish application in your choice of shade. Upgrade to a gel manicure or pedicure for a result that stays chip-free for two to three weeks. The perfect finishing touch for any occasion or a well-deserved weekly self-care ritual.

Why Choose Us

The TA's Difference

✦

We don't just provide beauty services — we create experiences that leave a lasting impression. Here's what sets us apart from every other salon in Midrand.

🎨
True Artistry

Our technicians are artists first, beauticians second. Whether recreating a photo exactly or inventing something entirely new, the level of craft and detail in every set is unmatched. We take pride in results that make clients stop and stare — and then come straight back.

💬
Client-First Culture

Every appointment begins with a genuine consultation. We listen. We ask the right questions. We understand your lifestyle, your preferences, your nail health history, and your vision — then we deliver something tailored entirely to you. No cookie-cutter results here.

🌟
Consistent Excellence

One visit won't define us — our consistency will. Clients return month after month because the quality never wavers. As one of our loyal clients put it: "The service at TA's gets better each time I go there." That's the standard we hold ourselves to.

🎨
Custom Colour Mixing

Can't find the colour you're dreaming of? Neither can most salons. At TA's, we mix custom shades in-house until we get your exact vision right. It's this kind of extra effort that turns first-time clients into lifelong regulars.

🧴
Premium Products Only

We invest in professional-grade, skin-safe, long-lasting products for every service — from our wax formulas designed for sensitive skin to our pigments and gel brands selected for colour vibrancy and retention. Your health and results both matter to us.

🏡
Warm, Welcoming Space

Walk into TA's and feel immediately at ease. Our studio is clean, calming, and filled with the kind of warm energy that comes from a team that genuinely loves what they do and who they serve. Clients travel from across Midrand — and beyond — to experience it.
